rules: Do not replace existing golden physics, controls, DPR autotuner, telemetry, world quality autopilot or Depth Anything integration.
Use existing systems first; patch only missing DreamFog-specific behavior.
Never mark DreamFog certified or public until node verify.mjs --full exits 0.
On every failure: reproduce, identify root cause, fix, add or strengthen regression test, rerun failing gate, then rerun full gate.
After a verified fix run quality:learn-fix and regressions:capture so the server can reuse the solution.
Do not remove visual effects to make tests pass. Degrade cost adaptively by device/FPS while preserving the visual intent.
CPU/no-GPU path is mandatory for image depth preparation; GPU is optional acceleration only.
